_comment: Weekday NSE equity-segment trading holidays. Copy each year from the official NSE circular (nseindia.com > Resources > Exchange Communication > Holidays). The app refuses to trade in a year that is missing here. 2026 lists only the holidays still ahead as of 27 Nov 2026; past dates do not matter because historical candles already skip them.

2026.source: NSE circular: trading holidays for calendar year 2026
